name: Basel IV — SR 11-7 Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk Management
scope: Banking organisations using models for risk management, capital adequacy, and decisioning
summary: Requires a sound model risk management framework covering model development, implementation, use, validation, governance, policies, and controls. Algorithmic decisions must be explainable and evidence trails must be preserved for independent review.

requirements.title: Model development transparency
requirements.description: Model structure, inputs, and intended use must be documented in machine-readable form linked to the deployed model.

requirements.title: Validation of model outputs
requirements.description: Every model output must pass a structural validation gate before it is used in risk decisioning.

requirements.title: Governance scorecard coverage
requirements.description: A risk-management scorecard covering entity identification, constraint definition, and boundary validation must be produced on a recurring basis.

requirements.title: Provenance of every model decision
requirements.description: Every model decision must carry agent attribution and observation timestamps sufficient to reconstruct the decision chain.

requirements.title: Confidence and derivation audit
requirements.description: Confidence scores and derivation methods must be recorded for every observation used in model input or output.

requirements.title: Policy governance coverage
requirements.description: Each model-driven event must name the governing policy and its compliance outcome.

requirements.title: Source attribution completeness
requirements.description: At least 90% of observations must carry full source attribution (recorded_by and observed_at).

requirements.title: Independent review artefact
requirements.description: A PROV-O chain for the decision under audit must be exportable for independent third-party review.
